title: ci(release): the Version PR lane reads the v3 `.changeset/pre/` layout (changesets/action v2.1.2, pinned by commit) and rehearses that read before the cut
body:
Fixes #23282

Clause-②: no (release CI)

One file, one job: `.github/workflows/release.yml`, the `version-pr` job (Version PR maintenance). No publish-lane line is touched.

## What broke, measured

- The scheduled `Release` run 38395962884 failed in `Version PR maintenance` at the PR step with `ENOENT ... .changeset/pre/changes.md`. The job log shows `changesets/action@v1` resolved to `a45c4d594aa4e2c509dc14a9f2b3b67ba3780d0d`, which is the v1.9.0 tag.
- The repository's own CLI is fine. `pnpm changeset status` exits 0 on `main`. In the same failing run, the "Render the post-version tree" step ran `pnpm run version` (changeset v3.0.3) to completion.
- The failing reader is the action's own copy. v1.9.0 bundles `@changesets/read` 0.6.7. Its legacy v1 reader treats every directory under `.changeset/` as an old folder changeset and opens `DIR/changes.md` and `DIR/changes.json`. Since the 18.0.0-next.0 cut, `.changeset/pre/` is such a directory.
- **Reproduced with the same code:** the v1.9.0 bundle, run on a scratch copy of `main` at `9c7cfbf0a9` (local mock API, no remote), fails at the same point (`setting GitHub credentials`) with the same error. The workflow-shaped replay of the base workflow fails the same way.

## What this changes

1. **PR step: `changesets/action` v2.1.2, pinned by commit** (`ae32849d5ba541f9ae29e40e22a623bc13562f51`). v2 is the major upstream pairs with `@changesets/cli` v3. It bundles `@changesets/read` 1.0.0, which reads `.changeset/pre/`. In `pre` mode, `readChangesetState` leaves `pre/` ids out of `hasChangesets`; in `exit` mode it keeps them. The inputs move to v2's names: `github-token`, `version-script`, `commit-message`, `pr-title`. v2 throws on each v1 name instead of ignoring it. `push-with-git-cli: true` keeps v1's git-CLI push. `create-github-releases: false` stays, and `push-git-tags: false` is added; both only matter if a publish script were ever added. The `GITHUB_TOKEN` env is dropped, because v2 takes the token only through `github-token`.
   - It is a commit and not `@v2` because upstream `v2` is a branch. A moving ref would change the bundled reader without any diff here.
2. **The card's pin: a read rehearsal on the post-version tree.** Three new steps go between "Validate the post-version tree" and "Restore the pre-version tree". They copy the rendered `.changeset/` (plus the root `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and a `node_modules` link) to a directory outside every git work tree. They run the **same pinned action** there with no credential, then require `has-changesets` == `false`.
   - The rendered tree is the tree the next cut lands on `main`. A reader that cannot read what the CLI writes now goes red while the Version Packages PR is still open, not on the first refresh after it merges.
   - **It cannot write.** The only path out of a "pending" read is `runVersion`, and its first act is `git checkout`. In a directory that is not a repository, that fails before any push or API call.
3. **Bounded in-place fix, same defect class:** the lane's pending count treated `.changeset/pre/*.md` as pending in every mode. In `pre` mode those changesets are consumed (the CLI's `getRelevantChangesets`), so they are now counted only on `pre exit`.
   - Measured on the post-version tree, which is the tree right after next.1 merges with nothing new: the old count reads `539` pending, the version pass moves `0` paths, and "Validate the post-version tree" goes red with `changesets were pending but the version step moved no path`. That would have been the first scheduled tick after next.1.
   - The same count fix is made in the Restore step. There the mode is read from the restored tree, because a `pre exit` version deletes `pre.json`.
   - All four in-place conditions hold: same class (a lane reader that does not know the v3 `pre/` layout), a mechanical fix whose shape the CLI pins, no other claim on the file, and no new verification surface.

## #6170: this lane still cannot publish

The pinned v2.1.2 `src/index.ts` branches on `hasPublishScript = !!core.getInput("publish-script")`:

- With no changesets and no publish script, it returns.
- With changesets, it runs `runVersion`, the PR path only.
- `runPublish` needs a `publish-script`, and neither invocation passes one.

The rehearsal invocation also runs in a non-repository directory with no token. The publish job, the environment gate and the tag push are untouched. Measured: every replay below reports `published=false`.

## Evidence

All runs were local, on scratch copies of `main` (an independent `git init` repo, its `origin` a scratch bare repo, the API a local mock). The real action bundles ran with the runner's `INPUT_*` and `GITHUB_*` contract. Nothing was dispatched and nothing reached GitHub.

| run | workflow | result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | this PR, `main` (32 new changesets + 507 consumed) | job green. Render `pending_before=32`; rehearsal `has-changesets=false`; restore `32 = 32`; PR step: `git push --force` of `chore: version packages (next)` by `github-actions[bot]`, then the GraphQL update of the existing PR (title `chore: version packages (next)`, body 4319 chars, the same length as #21988's). Rehearsal API requests: 0. |
| S1 content | (the pushed commit) | 32 R100 renames `.changeset/X.md` to `.changeset/pre/X.md` (exactly the 32 new ones), 168 M (79 `package.json`, 79 `CHANGELOG.md`, 10 `SKILL.md`), `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.0` to `18.0.0-next.1`. **The 507 consumed changesets: 0 blob mismatches, 0 missing.** |
| S2 | base (`main` at `9c7cfbf0a9`) | reverse control. PR step fails with ENOENT on `.changeset/pre/changes.json`. Which of the two parallel reads rejects first varies; CI showed `changes.md`. |
| S4 | this PR, rehearsal ref swapped to `@v1` | pin's reverse control. The rehearsal fails with ENOENT on `.changeset/pre/changes.md`, the PR step is skipped, and the standing PR keeps its last validated content. This is with `setupGitUser: false`. With v1's default it fails one call earlier, on `git config` in the non-repository directory. Red either way, before the cut. |
| S3 | this PR, zero-pending tree (post-version commit as `main`) | job green. `pending_before=0`, the rehearsal is skipped, and the PR step logs `No changesets present ... publish-script is not set.` |
| S3 base | base, same tree | the latent red. `pending_before=539`, then `Validate` fails with `changesets were pending but the version step moved no path`. |
| probe | v2.1.2 rehearsal on the PRE-version copy | `has-changesets=true`, then exit 1 at `git checkout` (`not a git repository`), 0 API requests. |
| exit | v2.1.2 bundled reader vs the lane count, `pre exit` scratch tree | both count 541 (34 + 507). `pre` mode, post-version: both 0. `pre` mode, pre-version: both 32. |

## Options weighed (the four axes)

- **(a) chosen: action v2.1.2 by commit, plus the read rehearsal.**
  - Real need: it opens next.1, and the rehearsal pins the exact failure.
  - Long-term: this is the upstream-sanctioned pairing for CLI v3, not a workaround. The second reader stays, but it is pinned and rehearsed on every refresh.
  - AI-proofing: a CLI or action bump that desyncs the readers goes red before the cut, and the pin makes the reader a reviewed diff.
  - Scope: one job, no new workflow, job or `check:*` script.
- **(b) a repo-owned version-PR script on the repo's CLI** (`pnpm run version`, commit, force-push, `gh pr create|edit`, PR body).
  - It has one reader by construction and no third-party code holding a write token.
  - It also replaces a maintained upstream component with new in-house PR machinery that only the live tick can fully verify. That is more surface on a p1 release lane.
  - Worth revisiting if the action and the CLI drift again.
- **(c) stay on v1 and keep `.changeset/pre/` away from it.** Ruled out by the card: no moving or deleting the consumed changesets, no `pre.json` edit, no skipped steps.

## The 2026-08-19 hold on v2 (#9208)

The maintainer kept v1 then (「同意 9208」). The recommendation was that a safety pin must not be upgraded before the property it encodes is read in v2's source. Its stated reopen path was: *read v2's source for the publish property and for the bundled reader*. Both are read above at the pinned commit, and the bundle was run end to end on the next.0-shaped tree. The other premise, "no measured pull", no longer holds: v1 cannot read the layout the repo's CLI writes. This PR reverses that hold, so it needs the maintainer's word as well as the Tier H approval.

## Verification

- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 40 families, all run, **all exit 0**, at `838bc026b5` (the final commit). `--ran` reconciliation: 40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The four artifact-roster gates whose roster lives under `.github/` were also run: all exit 0.
- **NOT MEASURED: the Validate step's content gates** (create-objectstack suite, release-notes gates and the rest). Reason: unchanged by this diff, so the emulation stubbed that step. The live tick runs them.
- **NOT MEASURED: GitHub-side behaviour** of v2's git-CLI push auth header and the PR create/update. Reason: only a live run measures it, and this lane is not dispatched while the PD15 question on #23193 is open. The local replay exercised the same code against a bare remote and a mock API.
- **NOT MEASURED: actionlint.** Reason: not installed here. The YAML parses, and `check:workflow-status-functions` and `check:workflow-step-name-quoting` scanned it green.
- **Live check after merge:** the next 6-hourly scheduled `Release` tick. Expected log lines: `Rehearse the version-PR changeset read ...` gives `No changesets present ...`; the assertion step gives `has-changesets=false`; and a `chore: version packages (next)` PR opens.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- #20562 landed nothing: it was closed `not_planned`, and the maintainer kept it closed on 2026-09-30. The scheduled rehearsal this pin extends is the `version-pr` job's own post-version render and validation.
- objectui's `changeset-release.yml` runs `changesets/action@v1` with `@changesets/cli` ^3.0.0. It would meet the same reader the first time a pre-mode version pass writes `.changeset/pre/` there. objectui has no `pre.json` today, so this is dormant. Carrier: none.
- The lane's README exclusion mirrors `@changesets/read` 0.x. Read 1.x also ignores `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `GEMINI.md` under `.changeset/`. Dormant: no such file exists.

## Changeset

None. This needs `skip-changeset`, and the label is left to the seat. The only changed path, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, belongs to no workspace package, so it is in no package's `files[]`. Positive control: `packages/spec/src/index.ts` resolves to `@objectstack/spec` (public), one of the 82 workspace packages (71 public).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
只改了发版工作流里"维护 Version Packages PR"这一个定时任务:
- 把它用的第三方 Action(changesets/action)从 v1 换成 v2.1.2,并按提交固定版本;
- 新增一次只读预演:每次刷新时,先用同一个 Action 去读"版本提交之后"的目录,读不懂就当场变红;
- 修正了"待发布 changeset"的计数:prerelease 模式下,`.changeset/pre/` 里已被消费的 changeset 不再算作待发布。

### 为什么改
18.0.0-next.0 切版后,已消费的 507 个 changeset 被移进 `.changeset/pre/`。v1 自带的旧读取器把这个目录当成 v1 时代的旧格式去读,每 6 小时一次的刷新都报 ENOENT。结果是 next.1 的 Version Packages PR 开不出来,next.1 无法发版。已在本地用同一份 Action 代码复现,并验证 v2.1.2 能正确开出 PR:只消费 next.0 之后的 32 个新 changeset,507 个旧的一字未动。计数修正针对的是 next.1 合入后、尚无新 changeset 时必然出现的一次误报变红。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
- "此车道不能发布"(#6170)不变:两处调用都不传 `publish-script`,v2 源码里没有发布脚本就走不到发布分支。预演在非仓库目录、无凭据下运行,写不出任何东西。
- v2 是大版本升级,推送方式与 PR 更新代码和 v1 不同。本地已用真实 Action 代码对着本地仓库和模拟 API 跑通,但 GitHub 侧行为要等合入后第一次定时运行才算实测。
- 这推翻了 2026-08-19「同意 9208」时保留 v1 的决定;当时写明的重开条件(读 v2 源码确认两条性质)已满足。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即可,不涉及任何仓库设置。

### 席位意见

### 你要做的
1. 审阅并批准本 PR:受管面 Tier H,且推翻了 #9208 当时的保留决定,需要你的明确同意。
2. 合入后无需任何操作:下一次 6 小时定时运行即是实测,应看到预演步骤输出 `has-changesets=false`,并开出 `chore: version packages (next)` PR。之后照常由你决定何时合并。
